story_fr: Le FFO dilué NAREIT progresse de 4,5 % à 0,46 $/action au T1 2026, confirmant la solidité de la génération de cash du portefeuille.
story_en: Diluted FFO per share rose 4.5% to $0.46 in Q1 2026, reflecting resilient cash generation across the portfolio.
quote: Diluted FFO per share of $0.46, representing 4.5% growth versus the prior year period.

story_fr: Le spread locatif atteint un niveau record de 410 points de base, représentant 77 M$ de loyers futurs additionnels, en hausse de 28 % sur un an.
story_en: The leased-to-economic occupancy spread hit a record 410 basis points, representing $77M in future ABR, up 28% year-over-year.
signal: Spread locatif record 410 bps = 77 M$ ABR futur
quote: Record leased-to-economic occupancy spread of 410 basis points, representing $77 million of future ABR.

story_fr: Le taux d'occupation du portefeuille atteint un niveau historique de 96,4 %, avec un record absolu pour les petites boutiques à 92,7 %.
story_en: Portfolio occupancy reached an all-time high of 96.4%, with small shop occupancy setting a new record at 92.7%.
quote: Pro-rata portfolio occupancy of 96.4%, an all-time high, with small shop occupancy of 92.7%, also a record.

story_fr: Moody's attribue à Kimco la note A3 sur la dette senior non garantie, portant la société au niveau A auprès des trois grandes agences de notation.
story_en: Moody's upgraded Kimco's senior unsecured debt to A3, making Kimco A-rated by all three major rating agencies.
signal: Note A3 Moody's, A-level chez les 3 agences
quote: Moody's upgraded our senior unsecured debt rating to A3, making Kimco A-rated at all three major agencies.

story_fr: Kimco relève son dividende trimestriel de 4 % à 0,26 $/action, soit 1,04 $ en base annuelle, soutenu par la croissance du FFO.
story_en: Kimco raised its quarterly dividend 4% to $0.26 per share ($1.04 annualized), supported by FFO growth.
quote: Declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.26 per common share, representing a 4% increase over the prior quarter.
